# Toastmusters Timer

> A free, browser-based speech timer built for the Timer role at Toastmasters
> meetings. It shows the standard green / yellow / red signals for every speech
> type, logs each speaker's exact time, and produces the Timer's end-of-meeting
> report. It also runs as a Zoom app that changes the Timer's virtual
> background colour automatically, so no one has to hold coloured cards to a
> webcam.

Name: Toastmusters Timer (the product name is a play on "Toastmasters"; the tool is
  an independent third-party app for Toastmasters club meetings, not affiliated with,
  endorsed by, or sponsored by Toastmasters International).
Topic: Toastmasters International (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Toastmasters_International,
  https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q917036) — meeting timing, the Timer role, speech time limits.
Site: https://www.timer.simple-tech.app/
Cost: Free. No account, sign-up, payment, or installation required.
Platform: Any modern web browser (desktop, tablet, phone) and Zoom.
Publisher: Simple Tech
Affiliation: Independent. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by
Toastmasters International.

## Key facts

- Standard Toastmasters timing rules are built in: Standard Speech 5–7 min
  (green 5:00, yellow 6:00, red 7:00), Table Topics 1–2 min (green 1:00,
  yellow 1:30, red 2:00), Evaluation 2–3 min (green 2:00, yellow 2:30,
  red 3:00), Longer Speech 7–9 min (green 7:00, yellow 8:00, red 9:00).
- Speakers have a 30-second grace period on either side of the range. In
  contests, finishing more than 30 seconds under the minimum or over the
  maximum disqualifies a speaker (Table Topics: under 1:00 or over 2:30).
  For meeting awards, each club sets its own rule; some require reaching green.
- Three ways to display the signal: full-screen colour in the browser, a
  floating overlay, or an automatic Zoom virtual background.
- The Zoom app changes the background colour on its own as thresholds are
  reached — it does not require screen sharing or physical cards.
- Timing data stays in the browser; the tool does not require an account.

- [Toastmasters Timer (home)](https://www.timer.simple-tech.app/): What the tool
  does, the three display modes, and the standard timing rules.
- [Open the timer](https://www.timer.simple-tech.app/app): The timer itself.
- [Timer Role Guide](https://www.timer.simple-tech.app/toastmasters-timer-role-guide):
  What the Timer does before, during, and after a meeting; step-by-step
  instructions, tips, and common mistakes.
- [Speech Types & Timing Rules](https://www.timer.simple-tech.app/toastmasters-speech-types-and-timing):
  Complete reference for every Toastmasters speech type and its green/yellow/red
  thresholds.
- [Timing Chart](https://www.timer.simple-tech.app/toastmasters-timing-chart):
  Visual colour reference table for all speech types.
- [Timer Script and Report Template](https://www.timer.simple-tech.app/toastmasters-timer-script):
  Word-for-word script for explaining the signals and delivering the timing
  report, plus a fill-in log.
- [Table Topics Timer](https://www.timer.simple-tech.app/table-topics-timer):
  Table Topics timing rules (1–2 minutes) and how to time a rapid-fire session.
- [Speech Contest Timing Rules](https://www.timer.simple-tech.app/toastmasters-speech-contest-timing-rules):
  How contest timing differs from club meetings, including disqualification
  rules.
- [How to Use Zoom for Toastmasters](https://www.timer.simple-tech.app/how-to-use-zoom-for-toastmasters):
  Running the Timer role in an online or hybrid meeting.
- [Free Zoom Timer Backgrounds](https://www.timer.simple-tech.app/toastmasters-zoom-timer-backgrounds):
  Downloadable green, yellow, and red virtual backgrounds, and how to install
  them in Zoom.
- [Best Toastmasters Timer Apps Compared](https://www.timer.simple-tech.app/best-toastmasters-timer-apps):
  Honest comparison of the available timer tools, including alternatives.
